hypothesis: At matched actual bitrate, better tokenizer latent fidelity is not necessarily better generative reconstruction.

target.source: original GT x through fixed pretrained Open-MAGVIT2 2^18 / 18-channel EMA encoder
target.preprocessing: FP32 RGB [0,1] -> replicate bottom 8 pixels to 1088x1920 -> 2*x-1; no resize; shared by all methods
target.normalized_version: derived diagnostic F.normalize(dim=1); NOT asserted to be original training target

fidelity.discrete_metrics: only after verifying discrete semantics; no hard-signing actual continuous inputs as if transmitted tokens
fidelity.unreproduced: L_margin exact formula unavailable; neither guessed nor labeled reproduced; image-domain L1+LPIPS is supervision, not a latent metric

utility.FID: dataset/method/QP pooled distribution; no framewise pairing

matching.unit: dataset/video/method vs Original; all 10x10 actual-rate QP pairs

inversion.tolerance: max observed absolute metric difference over >=10 points independently decoded twice; no posthoc enlarged tolerance
inversion.primary_population: one primary <=1% pair per video/method; all eligible pairs secondary
inversion.noise_floor_selection: 10 points selected by SHA256(seed=20261014,dataset,video,method,QP) before quality; two fresh repeats per point

analyses: latent and quality residual correlations after separate linear fits against log(actual_bpp) with video/method fixed effects
correlation.bootstrap: 2000 video-cluster resamples; seed=20261014; preserve all points from sampled video

figures.B: matched delta latent vs delta quality with quadrants
figures.D: up to4 strict P cosine/LPIPS primary inversions, ascending gap then descending delta_cosine*(-delta_LPIPS); lexical final ties; fixed frame32

sensitivity_probe: optional supporting evidence only, after primary completion
decision: Strong / Partial / Not supported based on reliable repeated matched-rate evidence; missing data is NOT CASE 3
writes: per-worker parts only, single aggregation process
publish_gate: complete evaluation, report and integrity PASS before add/commit/push; only this experiment
commit_message: Add v6.31a latent fidelity vs generative utility audit
scope_authorization: User explicitly authorized paper_compatible_teacher_proxy after exact original training source was found unavailable.
claim_limit: All fidelity claims are relative to this fixed proxy; no exact original alignment-loss reproduction.
full_tensor_samples: fixed random seed 20261014; 4 points; frames 1,32; no quality-based selection

decision_rule.reliable_counterexample: P proxy cosine worse beyond repeat tolerance OR same within tolerance, and >=2 of LPIPS/DISTS/FloLPIPS improved
decision_rule.Strong: >=4 reliable B1 primary pairs across >=2 datasets, >=4 videos and >=2 distinct QP pairs
decision_rule.Partial: at least one reliable B1 primary counterexample below Strong coverage
decision_rule.Not_supported: primary B1 matched pairs exist but no reliable counterexample
decision_rule.quantized_and_other_latent_metrics: separate diagnostic inversion counts; do not replace the primary cosine criterion
